title: Zelensky: US Floated NATO Membership for Ukraine in Exchange for Ceding Donbas
detail: Zelensky said Washington has floated NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for Kyiv ceding the Donbas territory. The claim is Ukraine's account of US proposals; no independent confirmation from Washington was reported in the cited coverage. Al Jazeera also reported three people killed in Russia the same day.

media.caption: Zelensky says US floated NATO membership in exchange for Donbas
